errors.what: First two packs: frontmatter concept_names did not land in shared/data.yaml. Initial attempt used a <script id=clan-frontmatter> JSON block (pack-html only reads a YAML --- block); second attempt used a top-level --- block with concept_names flat — still not merged (data.yaml unchanged, fields_changed listed only human/index.html).
errors.recovered_by: Read prior hop's receipt-account-planner.json which documented the same gotcha: pack-html only ingests frontmatter data nested under a `structured:` key. Nested concept_names under structured:, re-packed; key then present verbatim in shared/data.yaml.

problems_and_friction: pack-html frontmatter requires data nested under a `structured:` key; flat keys are silently dropped (no error, validate still OK), which is an easy trap. The prior hop's receipt was the fastest path to the answer. The pack also emitted a teaching hint suggesting patch-data is faster/branch-safe for data-only fields.
